source_caption: Anger Management (2003) is a comedy film starring as a mild-mannered man who’s wrongly forced into anger management therapy, led by an unorthodox and aggressive therapist played by . As the sessions become increasingly bizarre, his life spirals into chaos, leading to hilarious and unpredictable situations. The movie blends humor with themes of self-control and misunderstanding, making it a fun and memorable comedy.

source_details.title: Anger Management
source_details.synopsis: Anger Management is a 2003 American comedy film directed by Peter Segal and written by David S. Dorfman. Starring Adam Sandler and Jack Nicholson with Marisa Tomei, Luis Guzmán, Woody Harrelson and John Turturro in supporting roles, the film tells the story of a businessman who is sentenced to an anger management program under a renowned therapist with unconventional methods. This was the final film role for Lynne Thigpen, who died weeks before its release and is dedicated in her memory. Released in theaters in the United States on April 11, 2003, by Sony Pictures Releasing, the film received mixed reviews from critics and grossed $195.7 million against a $75 million budget.
